title: Staged uplift gating by security review and contract-term batching
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Proposal for a staged uplift (price/per-token uplift) that is gated by completion of the customer security questionnaire and batched by contract-term bands. Goal: increase realized ARR on renewals and expansions while protecting conversion by giving a clear path to lower uplift via security completions and term commitments.
background: We observe a widening gap between committed ARR in high-touch enterprise renewals and actual usage-driven expansions. Sales teams are requesting clearer price levers that (a) reward longer contract terms, (b) surface security/compliance effort as a gating mechanism for discounts, and (c) reduce finance overhead by batching small midmarket renewals into term bands. Current playbooks rely heavily on manual true-ups and ad-hoc uplift requests which increases sales friction and under-indexes for security completion delays.
proposed_solution: Introduce a two-axis uplift framework: (1) Security-Gated Uplift: apply a configurable uplift percentage at renewal/expansion start that is automatically reduced once the customer completes the security questionnaire and required SSO/KMS controls (clear checklist). (2) Term-Banded Discounts: define discrete term bands (12, 24, 36 months) with predefined discount offsets that partially offset the uplift. Implement automated billing flags and a new renewal template that calculates net uplift in real-time. Experiment with a control cohort (no gating) and two treatment cohorts: gated-within-90-days and gated-within-180-days. Track conversion, time-to-complete-security, uplift realized, and churn.
acceptance_criteria: Pricing UI shows calculated uplift and term-banded offset in the renewal quote
Security checklist link and progress exposed to customer and CSM in renewal dashboard
Automated billing metadata flag toggles discount once security checklist is marked complete
Experiment cohorts provisioned with randomized assignment and tracked in analytics
Observed sample: >=200 renewal events across cohorts over experiment window
No more than 5% increase in renewal call volume attributable to confusion (tracked by CS tickets)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Pilot): 8-week pilot with 100 accounts in US midmarket segment, CSM manual nudges for security completion. Phase 2 (Scale): expand to 500 accounts, automate checklist reminders and billing flag. Phase 3 (GA): add to sales renewal templating and enable for EMEA with localized messaging.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Customers see uplift as punitive -> Mitigation: clear comms + examples showing path to reduction
Risk: Security checklist completion is slow -> Mitigation: add technical SRE/solutions support hours as part of pilot
Risk: Finance needs manual true-up reconciliation -> Mitigation: build billing metadata flag and export for reconciliation
open_questions: What is the minimal security checklist that can be guaranteed to be completed within 90 days?
Should uplift be applied to list price or discounted baseline for customers already on legacy credits?
How granular should term bands be for enterprise (>36 months or custom?)
notes: Discussed with Sales leadership 2025-02-18; Sales prefers 90-day default but will accept a 180-day fallback for large customers.
Security team requested a pilot 'fast-track' checkbox for customers with completed SOC2 evidence (2025-02-25).
Legal flagged need to avoid language that implies punitive price increases; compliance to review quote wording (2025-03-03).
